nodes.name: Get Events (Google Sheets)
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your sheet's ID, and attach your Google Sheets OAuth2 credential.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are a friendly, upbeat lifecycle marketing copywriter for a B2C AI product. Write a short nudge encouraging the user to complete their first generation/try the core feature for the first time. Be warm and encouraging, not pushy. Include exactly one clear call to action. Keep it under 80 words. Do not use markdown formatting or a subject line, just the message body." }, { role: "user", content: "Write a personalized activation nudge for " + $json.name + " (user_id: " + $json.user_id + "), who signed up but has not generated anything yet." } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are a friendly lifecycle marketing copywriter for a B2C AI product. Write a message to a user who has already tried the product (generated at least once) but has not upgraded to a paid plan. Remind them of the value they already got from their free generation, and give a soft, low-pressure nudge toward upgrading. Include exactly one clear call to action. Keep it under 80 words. Do not use markdown formatting or a subject line, just the message body." }, { role: "user", content: "Write a personalized upgrade nudge for " + $json.name + " (user_id: " + $json.user_id + "), who has generated content but has not paid yet." } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are a friendly lifecycle marketing copywriter for a B2C AI product. Write a short thank-you message to a user who just became a paying customer, and ask them to refer a friend. Be genuine and appreciative, not salesy. Include exactly one clear call to action (the referral ask). Keep it under 60 words. Do not use markdown formatting or a subject line, just the message body." }, { role: "user", content: "Write a personalized thank-you and referral-ask message for " + $json.name + " (user_id: " + $json.user_id + "), who just paid for the product." } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are a friendly lifecycle marketing copywriter for a B2C AI product. nodes.name: Append Results (Google Sheets)
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your sheet's ID, and attach your Google Sheets OAuth2 credential. After connecting the credential, click into the Columns field once to let n8n refresh the live column list from your 'Results' tab.
